decisions.context: batchController initiateBatch used per-student session loop
decisions.decision: Replace with two parallel bulkWrite calls (requests + approvals collection)
decisions.trade_offs: Loses per-document Mongoose middleware, but those were not used here. Gains ~30x speed.
Slightly more code per mutation, but prevents thundering-herd cache miss storms at peak load.

decisions.decision: Removed populate — use denormalized facultyName field stored on NodueApproval at creation time
decisions.trade_offs: No extra Faculty collection query on the hot path. Name must be kept in sync on faculty rename (rare).

decisions.context: HoD overview cache not busting after class-teacher/mentor/faculty approvals
decisions.decision: All approval mutations now call invalidateKeys('hod_overview:<deptId>') immediately after transaction commit
decisions.trade_offs: Requires batch.departmentId in every approval function — already fetched for auth checks, so zero extra DB round-trips.

decisions.context: Setup Wizard missing from sidebar and department classes zero-state
decisions.decision: Declared Setup Wizard in NAV_CONFIG for Admin and HoD by default, gated by feature flag only when explicitly disabled; added dual entry points on DepartmentClasses (top action bar + zero-state onboarding card) with automatic department context passing via URL query
decisions.trade_offs: Guarantees zero-latency rendering of wizard navigation, eliminates user confusion when onboarding classes for an empty department.

decisions.context: Write conflict (code 112) when bulk removing subjects mapping
decisions.decision: Replaced frontend Promise.all parallel individual DELETE requests with an atomic POST /api/classes/:id/subjects/bulk-remove endpoint and bulkSyncSubjectRemoval, backed by exponential backoff write conflict retry logic
decisions.trade_offs: Consolidates N concurrent database transactions into 1 atomic mutation, eliminating race conditions and WiredTiger lock contention.

decisions.context: Inconsistent border radii across forms, SearchableSelect (0px inherited bug), cards, and modals
decisions.decision: Established formal CSS custom properties (--radius-micro 6px, --radius-chip 8px, --radius-control 12px/rounded-xl, --radius-surface 16px/rounded-2xl, --radius-pill 9999px/rounded-full) in index.css and normalized all UI primitives, form controls, and cards across client/src
decisions.trade_offs: Eliminates arbitrary border-radius overrides and achieves concentric geometry throughout the application.

decisions.context: Inconsistent button sizes, SearchableSelect multi-line trigger height, and filter/toolbar vertical misalignment across modals and admin/faculty pages
decisions.decision: Enforced deterministic fixed height tiers on Button (xs h-8, sm h-9, md h-10, lg h-11), SearchableSelect triggers (sm h-9, default h-11 with single-line label and subLabel strictly inside dropdown menu + title tooltip), modal inputs (h-11), wizard form controls (h-9), and page filter capsules/action bars (matching h-9 or h-10/h-11 baselines with inline-flex alignment)
decisions.trade_offs: Fixed heights prevent vertical wobble across heterogeneous controls in multi-column grids and horizontal toolbars, at the cost of truncating long subLabels on closed SearchableSelect triggers.
